newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle sales thin at $68 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle sales thin at $68 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were slow, with light sales reported at $68.00 per cwt Thursday morning, steady with Wednesday's active trade, feedlot sources said.

Less than 1,000 head that should grade select/choice sold in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area, sources there said. But most showlists were sold out following hefty sales on Wednesday, they said.
Panhandle sales Wednesday were pegged at 79,300 head, which brought the week to date figure to 95,900, USDA said early Thursday. The showlist had been estimated near 92,000.
